reader.title: Reader
reader.description: Platform that produced the spatial data

technology.title: Technology
technology.description: Platform that produced the input data. Determines which reader is used and what the input dataset must contain.
technology.help_text: Xenium, MERSCOPE, CosMx, Molecular Cartography, MACSima and Hyperion read a machine-output directory. PhenoCycler and OME-TIFF read a single all-channel image file, which must be the only such file in the input dataset. Visium HD is not available here: it needs a Space Ranger reference and a different samplesheet.

tissue_segmentation.title: Tissue Segmentation
tissue_segmentation.description: Optional detection of the tissue region before cell segmentation

use_tissue_segmentation.title: Run tissue segmentation
use_tissue_segmentation.description: Restrict the analysis to the region of the slide covered by tissue.

level.title: Image pyramid level
level.description: Level of the image pyramid used for tissue segmentation. Higher levels are lower resolution and faster.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Which signal separates tissue from background.

image_preprocessing.title: Image Preprocessing
image_preprocessing.description: Applied before the channel-based segmentation methods (Cellpose, StarDist) only

gaussian_sigma.title: Gaussian sigma
gaussian_sigma.description: Standard deviation of the Gaussian blur applied before segmentation (scipy gaussian_filter).

clip_limit.title: CLAHE clip limit
clip_limit.description: Contrast limit for adaptive histogram equalization (skimage equalize_adapthist).

clahe_kernel_size.title: CLAHE kernel size
clahe_kernel_size.description: Kernel size for adaptive histogram equalization (skimage equalize_adapthist).

cellpose.title: Cellpose Segmentation
cellpose.description: Channel-based segmentation; patches are measured in pixels

use_cellpose.title: Run Cellpose
use_cellpose.description: Segment cells from channel intensities using Cellpose.

cellpose_channels.title: Channels
cellpose_channels.description: Channel name(s) to segment on, for example DAPI. Separate multiple names with a space, comma or pipe.

cellpose_model_type.title: Model
cellpose_model_type.description: Cellpose model to use, for example cyto3 or nuclei.

flow_threshold.title: Flow threshold
flow_threshold.description: Cellpose flow_threshold. Raise it to accept more cells.

cellprob_threshold.title: Cell probability threshold
cellprob_threshold.description: Cellpose cellprob_threshold. Lower it to accept more cells.

cellpose_use_gpu.title: Use GPU
cellpose_use_gpu.description: Run Cellpose on a GPU. Requires a compute environment with GPU instances available.

stardist.title: StarDist Segmentation
stardist.description: Channel-based segmentation; patches are measured in pixels

use_stardist.title: Run StarDist
use_stardist.description: Segment cells from channel intensities using StarDist.

stardist_model_type.title: Model
stardist_model_type.description: Name of the StarDist model to use.

stardist_channels.title: Channels
stardist_channels.description: Channel name(s) to segment on. Separate multiple names with a space, comma or pipe.

nms_thresh.title: NMS threshold
nms_thresh.description: StarDist nms_thresh, the non-maximum-suppression overlap limit.

proseg.title: Proseg Segmentation
proseg.description: Transcript-based segmentation. Proseg runs on the whole slide at once, so leave Patch width (microns) at -1

use_proseg.title: Run Proseg
use_proseg.description: Segment cells from transcript positions using Proseg.

infer_presets.title: Infer presets
infer_presets.description: Derive the Proseg presets from the columns of the transcript dataframe rather than setting them explicitly.

command_line_suffix.title: Extra arguments
command_line_suffix.description: Appended verbatim to the Proseg command line.

baysor.title: Baysor Segmentation
baysor.description: Transcript-based segmentation; patches are measured in microns

use_baysor.title: Run Baysor
use_baysor.description: Segment cells from transcript positions using Baysor.

baysor_scale.title: Scale (microns)
baysor_scale.description: Typical cell radius in microns. -1 lets Baysor estimate it.

baysor_scale_std.title: Scale standard deviation
baysor_scale_std.description: Expected spread of cell radii, as a value or a percentage of the scale.

prior_segmentation_confidence.title: Prior segmentation confidence
prior_segmentation_confidence.description: How much to trust a prior segmentation, from 0 to 1. Only used when a prior shapes key is set.

min_molecules_per_cell.title: Minimum molecules per cell
min_molecules_per_cell.description: Cells with fewer transcripts are discarded.

min_molecules_per_gene.title: Minimum molecules per gene
min_molecules_per_gene.description: Genes with fewer transcripts are ignored.

force_2d.title: Force 2D
force_2d.description: Ignore the z coordinate of the transcripts.

comseg.title: ComSeg Segmentation
comseg.description: Transcript-based segmentation; patches are measured in microns

use_comseg.title: Run ComSeg
use_comseg.description: Segment cells from transcript positions using ComSeg.

alpha.title: Alpha
alpha.description: ComSeg alpha, controlling the concavity of the cell boundaries.

min_rna_per_cell.title: Minimum RNA per cell
min_rna_per_cell.description: Cells with fewer transcripts are discarded.

patches.title: Patches
patches.description: The slide is cut into patches and segmented in parallel. Channel-based methods (Cellpose, StarDist) use the pixel settings; transcript-based methods (Proseg, Baysor, ComSeg) use the micron settings

patch_width_pixel.title: Patch width (pixels)
patch_width_pixel.description: Width and height of each image patch, in pixels.

patch_overlap_pixel.title: Patch overlap (pixels)
patch_overlap_pixel.description: Overlap between image patches, in pixels. About twice a cell diameter works well.

patch_width_microns.title: Patch width (microns)
patch_width_microns.description: Width and height of each transcript patch, in microns. Use -1 for a single patch covering the whole slide, which Proseg requires.

patch_overlap_microns.title: Patch overlap (microns)
patch_overlap_microns.description: Overlap between transcript patches, in microns. About twice a cell diameter works well.

image_scale.title: Image scale
image_scale.description: Pyramid scale used for the image patches, for example scale1. Defaults to the highest resolution.

prior_shapes_key.title: Prior shapes key
prior_shapes_key.description: Boundaries to use as a segmentation prior: either a column of the transcript dataframe or a shapes key of the SpatialData object.
prior_shapes_key.help_text: When Cellpose is combined with Proseg, Baysor or ComSeg this is set to cellpose_boundaries automatically.

unassigned_value.title: Unassigned value
unassigned_value.description: Value the prior gives to transcripts that fall outside every cell. Leave empty if that value is already 0.

filtering.title: Cell Filtering
filtering.description: Removal of low-quality cells during and after segmentation

min_area_pixels2.title: Minimum cell area (pixels squared)
min_area_pixels2.description: Smaller cells are discarded. Applies to Cellpose and StarDist.

min_area_microns2.title: Minimum cell area (microns squared)
min_area_microns2.description: Smaller cells are discarded. Applies to Baysor and ComSeg, not to Proseg.

min_transcripts.title: Minimum transcripts per cell
min_transcripts.description: Cells with fewer transcripts are discarded.

min_intensity_ratio.title: Minimum intensity ratio
min_intensity_ratio.description: Cells whose mean channel intensity is below this fraction of the 90th percentile are discarded.

aggregation.title: Aggregation
aggregation.description: Building the cell-by-gene and cell-by-channel tables

aggregate_genes.title: Aggregate genes
aggregate_genes.description: Count the transcripts of each gene inside each cell.

aggregate_channels.title: Aggregate channels
aggregate_channels.description: Average the intensity of each channel inside each cell.

expand_radius_ratio.title: Expand radius ratio
expand_radius_ratio.description: Grow each cell polygon by this multiple of the mean cell radius before averaging channels, which captures boundary stainings. Affects channel averaging only.

scanpy_preprocessing.title: Scanpy Preprocessing
scanpy_preprocessing.description: Optional table preprocessing after aggregation and annotation

use_scanpy_preprocessing.title: Run scanpy preprocessing
use_scanpy_preprocessing.description: Normalize, log-transform and cluster the aggregated table, and compute a UMAP.

resolution.title: Leiden resolution
resolution.description: Resolution of the Leiden clustering. Higher values give more clusters.

hvg.title: Use highly variable genes
hvg.description: Select highly variable genes before computing the UMAP and clusters.

check_counts.title: Check counts
check_counts.description: Verify that the table holds raw counts before normalizing.

fluorescence_annotation.title: Fluorescence Annotation
fluorescence_annotation.description: Optional marker-based cell-type annotation, for channel-based data

use_fluorescence_annotation.title: Run fluorescence annotation
use_fluorescence_annotation.description: Assign a cell type to each cell from its brightest marker channel.

marker_cell_dict.title: Marker to cell type map
marker_cell_dict.description: Python dictionary, as a string, mapping marker channel names to the cell type each marker identifies.

fluorescence_cell_type_key.title: Cell type key
fluorescence_cell_type_key.description: Column of the cell table the annotation is written to.

explorer.title: Xenium Explorer Output
explorer.description: The .explorer output opens in 10x Genomics Xenium Explorer

pixel_size.title: Pixel size (microns)
pixel_size.description: Microns per pixel. A wrong value makes the scale bar in Explorer wrong.

lazy.title: Load images lazily
lazy.description: Keep images on disk instead of in memory, unless they are smaller than the RAM threshold below.

ram_threshold_gb.title: RAM threshold (GB)
ram_threshold_gb.description: Images smaller than this are loaded into memory even when lazy loading is on.
